description: Pacific Harbour Hydrographic Survey August 2022 is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Port of Brisbane Pty Ltd were commissioned by City of Moreton Bay (CMB) to undertake an investigation hydrographic survey of the Pacific Harbour Canal estate and a portion of the adjacent Pumicestone Passage. Coverage: City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The portal files it under the publisher City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Its tags are hydrographic, survey. It offers 2 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, html. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
